digest.component_or_area: DC data center reconciler - hierarchy/parent field sync
propositions: A sub-task's parent field on DC 8.17.1 is silently accept-and-ignore; no write mechanism exists to move a sub-task to a different parent.
Two live test cells (inbound and outbound set parent) were wrong oracles asserting platform operations that cannot be performed, not symptoms of rebar implementation gaps.

The emit-side parent suppression for non-epic parents returned indistinguishable from 'unbound, retry next pass' with zero durable operator-visible record, violating the project contract on divergence signaling.
Re-homing the three failing cells to Epic Link mechanics (non-sub-task child shape) preserves the user-visible contract while asserting only supported operations.
When a user sets a parent the tracker cannot represent for a child shape, rebar must emit a durable bridge alert naming the reason and supported alternative, not silently drop it and exit 0.
